ria_eval: Flagging a QA/regression after the int4 tokenizer merge. Long QA holdout shows 3.8% drop in exact match; seems tied to shingle fingerprint changes and whitespace normalization.

ria_eval: Failing examples (short): 720001,720045,720099. Baseline q5b-fp16 returns gold answers; q5b-int4 sometimes truncates or drops list items.

omar_labelops: We'll run a pre-tokenization fingerprint pass and a 250-item micro-golden if novel fingerprints appear. Please share SQL to pull the candidate set.

sylvie_infra: deploy-bot logged the canary: q5b-int4 rolled to staging 2025-12-05T09:11:00Z. I'll add a temporary routing rule: if request.tokens>1100 route to fp16 and tag telemetry.

ria_eval: SQL used to pull candidates:
```
SELECT id, intent, length_chars, fingerprint FROM promptset_ingest
WHERE intent IN ('longqa','tutorial')
AND length_chars > 900
AND created_at >= '2025-11-01'
LIMIT 800;
```

omar_labelops: Running fingerprint diff job now: `jobs/fp_diff.py --snap snap_202511 --live live --out /tmp/fp_delta.csv`. If delta rate > 2% we'll schedule micro-gold and exclude fingerprints matching existing gold. ETA labels: 24-30h.

sylvie_infra: I'll implement feature flag for routing so we can toggle quickly and record fallback counts.

ria_eval: Plan: (1) run the 800-sample A/B today (2) run fp diff and start 250 micro-gold if needed (3) hold rollout until halluc_rate delta <0.02. Update here with metrics.

omar_labelops: Ack, will post job link and progress.
